about_the_game:
Overview

The Idle Undead is an Idle Clicker game set in a Zombie Apocalypse!

Click to defeat enemies, get loot and cash and spend it to upgrade your base and recruit survivors to help you in your survival.

Gameplay

The Idle Undead is a clicker game where you recruit survivors and purchase various upgrades to progress, You start by clicking on the screen to earn points, that you spend to recruit fellow survivors to defeat the enemies around you!

Enemies drop various rewards, such as XP and Resources you put towards levelling up to unlock new areas and upgrades, with more advanced features unlocking the further you progress.

Minigames - Play fun small minigames to give a boost to your damage and defeat the zombies faster!

Recruit Survivors - You can level up your base with various upgrades to help you in-game!

Cards - Open crates dropped after bosses to earn cards, These cards provide an effect when used and are then destroyed, You can strategize when to use these to help you in difficult situations

Unlock Skills - Progress through the game and unlock Skills to help you fight back, Unlock cool mechanics to make the Idle gameplay more fun as you play!

Story

The game is set several years after the outbreak of a virus that transforms the population into mutated zombie-like creatures, Originating amongst the wealthy who spread the virus slowly down to the common population, it's true origin is unknown, but the mutated creatures show plant like roots within them.

Find newspapers and additional lore as you progress in game to get the full story!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3 / Fedora
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 550 or Greater
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: With 30 FPS Limit
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS 3 / Fedora
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 570 or Greater
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Tested on Fedora 37, and SteamOS 3 on a Steam Deck

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS Catalina
  • Processor: I5-4260U
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: With 30 FPS Limit - This is the only tested setup for MacOS, other OS versions etc may or may not work
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: MacOS Monterey
  • Processor: M1, M2+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: M1 or M2 Integrated
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
